subject: Climate & Environment
title: Glacial Lake Outburst Floods
description: One-minute skill: Glacial Lake Outburst Floods.

hook.text: Melting glaciers create lakes held back by walls of ice and rubble. When the wall breaks, disaster follows.

buildup.text: As glaciers retreat, meltwater pools behind natural dams made of loose rock and ice.

discovery.text: A glacial lake outburst flood — called a GLOF — can release millions of cubic meters in hours.

twist.text: Nepal has over 2,000 glacial lakes. At least 21 are classified as dangerous and growing.

climax.text: Climate change is accelerating glacier melt. Every year, more lakes form and more dams weaken.

punchline.text: Mountains are building dams that nobody designed — and nobody maintains.

details.summary: Glacial lake outburst floods occur when ice or moraine dams holding back meltwater lakes fail suddenly, releasing massive volumes of water downstream. As glaciers retreat and lakes grow, these events are becoming more frequent and threatening mountain communities worldwide.
details.whyItMatters: Millions of people live downstream of growing glacial lakes in the Himalayas, Andes, and Alps. GLOF risk is one of the most immediate climate dangers for mountain populations.
takeaways: Retreating glaciers create and expand unstable meltwater lakes
An outburst can release millions of cubic meters of water in hours
Nepal, Peru, and Bhutan face the highest GLOF risks

faq.question: How are communities protecting against glacial lake floods?
faq.answer: Engineers drain dangerous lakes by lowering water levels through siphons or controlled channels. Early warning systems using sensors and satellite monitoring alert downstream communities. Nepal and Bhutan have completed several such projects.

faq.question: How many glacial lakes are dangerous?
faq.answer: A 2023 study identified over 15,000 glacial lakes that have grown significantly since 1990. Of these, roughly 1,000 pose serious outburst risks, particularly in the Himalayas, Andes, and Alaska where glacial retreat is fastest.
